name: Keybindery
description: Chord keybinds and keybind UX for Fabric mods. Multi-key chords for any keymapping (vanilla + modded), in-config keybind API for consumer mods, auto-append fallback in vanilla / ModMenu / Cloth Config screens, controls-screen overhaul (search, sort, filter, MISC fix). Inspired by Amecs, Controlling, and Cloth Config.
